== Strategy ==

I took out combat responce in favor of Beldon's Eye (V)

First Turn you will be activating 5 Force and you search your reserve deck for 1 of 4 sites preferably not getting Platform 327.  While you have searched your reserve deck see if the Outrider and Dash Rendar are there and deploy them to control Bespin.

Second Turn Flip Objective.

I think Revealed & Path Of Least Resistance and A Jedi's Reslience make the deck work, because the first lets your characters be where they are most useful and Sorry About The Mess help clear out any Undercover Spies.  While A Jedi's Reslience lets the work horses of this deck i.e. Luke, Obi-Wan and Quigon stick around and off more Dark Side characters.

Side Note/Debate- What about starting with You Cannot Hide Forever & Staging Areas and if I have to use it to pull Wokling (V) if not I get some nice bonuses from the Effect.
